items.summary: Make the Admin Panel accessible at the path /admin (not only via hash routing), so that visiting https://<app-domain>/admin loads the Admin Panel UI and the in-app “Admin Panel” navigation button uses /admin.

Ensure the Admin Panel “AdMob Settings” section always renders for admins and correctly loads/saves the AdMob App ID and Rewarded Ad Unit ID using the backend APIs, with stable form state initialization (no state updates during render).

Add admin-configurable app logo management: provide Admin Panel UI to upload/replace a logo image, persist it in the backend, and display the saved logo in the app header in place of the default icon when available.

Implement real user management/overview in the Admin Panel: add backend admin-only APIs to list users and their stored profiles and session status, and update the Admin Panel to display this list (replacing the current placeholder).

Persist new/updated admin settings across upgrades: store global AdMob config and the uploaded logo in stable state, and add/adjust conditional migration logic as needed to preserve existing values on upgrade.
